review:
The dog gang heads to a dusty frontier town. A 5x3 grid with sheriff-badge wilds on reels 2, 3 and 4, each carrying a random 2x or 3x multiplier.

Three safe-shaped bonus symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 pay 5x and start free spins, with a 3x3 grid revealing how many you get. Sticky wilds in the bonus are the key to the 10,000x max. The 96.08% RTP is a little lower than some other Dog House games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
